label: Controller awareness
objective: Track the selected flight, identify its reported restriction, and explain what changed.
questions: Summarize the latest reported movement status and restriction for this aircraft.
What movement restriction is confirmed for this aircraft?
assistantFocus: Prioritise movement_condition, movement_status and route. Support identification and report-based handovers. Do not issue clearances, choose separation minima, or invent a runway reopening. This is awareness of the selected flight, not an operational traffic-control system.
assessment: Manual review of aircraft identity, evidence timing, reported restrictions, changes and acknowledged uncertainty; automatic trainee scoring not implemented.

label: Pilot awareness
objective: Review the selected flight’s reported route and restrictions; identify what needs confirmation.
questions: What route and movement restriction are reported for this aircraft?
What has changed in the reports for this aircraft?
assistantFocus: Prioritise route, movement_condition and movement_status for the selected flight. Distinguish a reported route or estimate from an operational clearance. Do not give cockpit procedures, control inputs, or permission to move. This is a surface briefing, not a cockpit or flight-dynamics simulator.
assessment: Manual review of aircraft identity, evidence timing, reported restrictions, changes and acknowledged uncertainty; automatic trainee scoring not implemented.

label: Ramp awareness
audience: Turnaround coordinators, ramp supervisors and ground-handling trainees
objective: Identify the service bottleneck and distinguish completed services from overall readiness.
questions: What is the latest update for this aircraft?
Is this aircraft ready to depart?
assistantFocus: Prioritise service updates and relevant movement restrictions. Completed services do not establish overall departure readiness or movement clearance.
assessment: Manual review of aircraft identity, evidence timing, reported restrictions, changes and acknowledged uncertainty; automatic trainee scoring not implemented.
